title: Global per-sample Q matrix (NGSadmix)
description: NGSadmix .qopt output, one row per sample, K columns each in [0,1] summing to 1. Sample order matches the run's samples.txt. The atlas reads this through a custom file format: the .qopt is whitespace-separated with NO header, so the layer entry uses format='tsv' and the consumer wraps each row's K values into a Q array.
_layer_doc: The .qopt is space- or tab-separated with K float columns and no header. The current layer_router parses with header=true; for this layer, the analysis module that consumes it must use the path to read the file fresh, OR we add a 'header: false' flag to the layer entry (~5 LOC change to layer_router.parseDelimited). Either approach. Default schema validates the post-processed shape: array of {sample_id, Q[]}.

Q.description: Per-cluster ancestry proportion. Length = K. Sum should be ~1.0.
